description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Annie''' hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals magic damage.
description.text: Active: Annie hurls a fireball at the target enemy that deals magic damage.

description2.raw: If this kills the target, ''Disintegrate's'' [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown is reduced by 50% and its [[File:Mana icon.svg|15px|link=Mana]] mana cost is refunded.
description2.text: If this kills the target, Disintegrate's  cooldown is reduced by 50% and its  mana cost is refunded.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 (+ 80% AP)

notes.raw: * ''Disintegrate'' will also grant the cooldown reduction and mana cost refund if the target is dead upon the missile's arrival. * If the target becomes [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|dies]], or is too far away or no longer in [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
notes.text:
Disintegrate will also grant the cooldown reduction and mana cost refund if the target is dead upon the missile's arrival.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).
